Deal Cards to UNO Players

deal_hands.Rd

Randomly shuffles a UNO deck and distributes 7 cards to each player. Cards are dealt in 7 sequential rounds, one card at a time to each player, maintaining fairness in order. After dealing, the function also initializes the discard pile by placing one card from the remaining deck face-up.

Usage

deal_hands(deck, n_players = 4)

Arguments

deck

A tibble representing a full UNO deck as generated by create_uno_deck. Must contain 108 UNO cards with columns: color, value, and type.

n_players

An integer indicating the number of players in the game. The default is 4, which reflects the standard size for quick simulations.
This version supports any number of players (≥2) based on deck size.
Note: Future versions of this package aim to support larger player counts with built-in validation and dynamic rule adaptation.

Value

A named list with the following components:

  • hands – A named list of tibbles, each containing 7 cards dealt to a player. Names follow the format "Player_1", "Player_2", etc.

  • deck – A tibble representing the remaining draw pile after all hands and the discard card have been removed.

  • discard – A one-row tibble containing the top card placed on the discard pile at the start of the game.

Details

This function is commonly used as the first step in setting up a game using setup_game or play_game.

- The cards are dealt using a nested loop: one card per player per round, repeated 7 times.
- Each player's hand is stored in a named list (e.g., Player_1, Player_2, etc.).
- One card is moved from the remaining deck to serve as the opening discard card.

The result can be passed directly to downstream functions like play_turns_loop to simulate gameplay.

Examples

# Generate a new UNO deck
deck <- create_uno_deck()
#> Error in expand_grid(color = colors, value = as.character(numbers)) %>%     mutate(type = "number") %>% group_by(value) %>% mutate(replication = if_else(value ==     "0", 1, 2)) %>% ungroup() %>% slice(rep(1:n(), replication)) %>%     select(-replication): could not find function "%>%"

# Deal cards to 4 players
deal <- deal_hands(deck, 4)
#> Error: object 'deck' not found

# View player 1's hand
deal$hands$Player_1
#> Error: object 'deal' not found

# View top of discard pile
deal$discard
#> Error: object 'deal' not found

# Check hand sizes (should all be 7)
sapply(deal$hands, nrow)
#> Error: object 'deal' not found

# Examine remaining deck structure
str(deal$deck)
#> Error: object 'deal' not found
